content.query:
WITH DimAccount AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimAccount 
    WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS', 'CCD', 'TRU', 'TRY')
)
,DimCustomer AS (
    SELECT 
    CustomerSK,CustomerID,CustomerName
    ,CASE
        WHEN SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' THEN CustomerType IN ('C','B')
        WHEN SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' THEN CustomerType IN ('CC')
        WHEN SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' THEN CustomerType IN ('C')
        END AS CustomerType
    ,DateOfBirth,MaritalStatus,Gender,MobileNumber,Email,AddressLine1,AddressLine2,City,Province,ZipCode,Country,DataPrivacyConsent,LastKYCDate,RiskRatingTypeSK,RiskRatingSK,SuspendedIndicator,RelationshipStartDate,PartySK,ATMEnrollmentIndicator,MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator,OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator,GenerationalCohort,PermanentCreditLimit,EmployerName,OfficeAddressLine1,OfficeAddressLine2,OfficeCity,OfficeProvince,OfficeZipCode,OfficeCountry,Industry,Occupation,BankSK,BranchSK,CurrentIndicator,ValidStartDate,ValidEndDate,SourceSystemCode,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm
    FROM DW.DimCustomer
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = 'Y'
)


SELECT
DDC.CustomerId AS 'Customer ID'
,DDC.CustomerName AS 'Customer Name'
,DDP.PartyID AS 'Global CIF'
,DDC.CustomerType AS 'Customer Type'
,DDC.DateOfBirth AS 'Birthdate'
,DDC.MaritalStatus AS 'Marital Status'
,DDC.Gender AS 'Gender'
,DDC.MobileNumber AS 'Mobile Number'
,DDC.Email AS 'Email Address'
,DDC.AddressLine1 AS 'Address Line 1'
,DDC.AddressLine2 AS 'Address Line 2'
,DDC.City AS 'City'
,DDC.Province AS 'Province'
,DDC.ZipCode AS 'Zip Code'
,DDC.Country AS 'Country'
,DDC.EmployerName AS 'Employer Name'
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine1 AS 'Office Address Line 1'
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine2 AS 'Office Address Line 2'
,DDC.OfficeCity AS 'Office City'
,DDC.OfficeProvince AS 'Office Province'
,DDC.OfficeZipCode AS 'Office Zip Code'
,DDC.Country AS 'Office Country'
,DDC.Industry AS 'Industry'
,DDC.Occupation AS 'Occupation'
,MIN(DA.AccountOpenedDate) AS 'Tenure'
,SUM(DFRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) AS 'Total Relationship Balance (FULL)'
,SUM(DFRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated) AS 'Total Relationship Balance (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull) AS 'Total MTD ADB PHP (Deposits) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated) AS 'Total MTD ADB PHP (Deposits) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) AS 'Total YTD ADB PHP (Deposits) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated) AS 'Total YTD ADB PHP (Deposits) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFDB.BalanceAmountFull) AS 'Total OutBal PHP (Deposits) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFDB.BalanceAmountProrated) AS 'Total OutBal PHP (Deposits) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFLE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS 'Total Relationship Exposure (Loans) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFLE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS 'Total Relationship Exposure (Loans) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFLB.OutstandingBalanceFull) AS 'Total OutBal PHP (Loans) (FULL) '
,SUM(DFLB.OutstandingBalanceProrated) AS 'Total OutBal PHP (Loans)(PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFLL.CreditLimitAmountFull) AS 'Total Credit Limit (Loans) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFLL.CreditLimitAmountProrated) AS 'Total Credit Limit (Loans)(PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFCE.RelationshipExposure) AS 'Total OutBal PHP (Cards) '
,SUM(DFCB.StatementBalance) AS 'Total Outstanding Balance (Cards)'
,SUM(DFCL.CurrentCreditLimit) AS 'Total Credit Limit (Cards)'
,SUM(DFTE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS 'Total Relationship Exposure (Loans + Cards) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFTE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS 'Total Relationship Exposure (Loans + Cards) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFP.PortfolioEndValueFull) AS 'Total Securities Portfolio Size (CBSEC) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFP.PortfolioEndValueProrated) AS 'Total Securities Portfolio Size (CBSEC) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFF.AUMAmountFull) AS 'Total Fund Value (Trust) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFF.AUMAmountProrated) AS 'Total Fund Value (Trust) (PRO-RATED)'
,SUM(DFI.OutstandingInvestmentFull) AS 'Total Outstanding Investment (TRY) (FULL)'
,SUM(DFI.OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS 'Total Outstanding Investment (TRY) (PRO-RATED)'
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent AS 'Data Privacy Consent'
,DDC.LastKYCDate AS 'Last KYC Date'
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName AS 'Risk Rating Type'
,DDR.RiskRatingName AS 'Risk Rating'
--,DDCA.SuspendedIndicator AS 'Suspended Indicator'
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator AS 'ATM Enrollment Indicator'
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS 'MBK Enrollment Indicator'
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS 'RIB/BOB Enrollment Indicator'
,DA.PayrollIndicator AS 'Payroll Indicator'
,DDC.GenerationalCohort AS 'Generational Cohort'
,DDMS.MarketSegmentName AS 'Market Segment'
,DDC.ValidStartDate AS 'LastUpdatedDate'
,DFRB.BusinessDateSK AS 'BusinessDate'

FROM 
DimCustomer DDC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimParty DDP ON DDC.PartySK = DDP.PartySK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DDCA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance DFRB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFRB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD DFMTD ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFMTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD DFYTD ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFYTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance DFDB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFDB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure DFLE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance DFLB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansCreditLimit DFLL ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLL.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure DFCE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance DFCB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsCreditLimit DFCL ON DDCA.AccountSK = DDCA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure DFTE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFTE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactSecurityPortfolio DFP ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTrustFundValue DFF ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFF.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment DFI ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFI.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DDT ON DDC.RiskRatingTypeSK = DDT.RiskRatingTypeSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DDR ON DDC.RiskRatingSK = DDR.RiskRatingSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DDMS ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DFRB.MarketSegmentSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDMS.MarketSegmentSK)

GROUP BY 
 DDC.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerName
,DDC.CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfBirth
,DDC.MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber
,DDC.Email
,DDC.AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2
,DDC.City
,DDC.Province
,DDC.ZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.EmployerName
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine1
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine2
,DDC.OfficeCity
,DDC.OfficeProvince
,DDC.OfficeZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.Industry
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.GenerationalCohort
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName
,DDR.RiskRatingName
,DDMS.MarketSegmentName
,DDP.PartyID
,DDC.Occupation
,DA.PayrollIndicator
,DDR.RiskRatingName
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName
,DDC.LastKYCDate
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent
--,DDCA.SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ValidStartDate
,DFRB.BusinessDateSK
